runScenarios.note: One named request over a ScenarioSet, MarketSnapshot, and builder-produced targets; returns the deeply frozen scenario-major analysis report.

scenarioPortfolioBinding.note: Opaque durable-portfolio binding namespace; ledger-owned economics remain separate from caller-bound valuation behavior.

scenarioPortfolioBinding.fullRevaluation.note: Bind one durable portfolio position identity to one Gate-C pricer without overriding ledger-owned quantity, multiplier, currency, account, or underlying.

scenarioPortfolioBinding.taylor.note: Bind one durable portfolio position identity to an explicit current-value Taylor approximation and complete base-factor coordinates.

scenarioTarget.note: Opaque target-builder namespace; behavior is bound privately and public replay descriptors remain inspectable.

scenarioTarget.fullRevaluation.note: Bind one instrument to one Gate-C pricer with explicit quantity, multiplier, currency, and canonical replay descriptor.

scenarioTarget.spot.note: Convenience target for one directly observed spot asset with contractMultiplier fixed to one.

scenarioTarget.taylor.note: Build an explicit Taylor approximation target from current per-unit value, raw sensitivities, and every meaningful base factor.

scenarioTargetsFromPortfolio.note: Pure adapter from a fully validated, detached FC7 PortfolioState plus opaque bindings to deterministic scenario targets.

spotAssetPricer.note: First-party Gate-C adapter whose per-unit result equals its exact declared spot observation.
